provenance.objects: 171 objects of messier.json and caldwell.json: J2000 RA and Dec as Skyfield Star, no proper motion
provenance.refraction: Skyfield altaz, 10 C, 1010 mbar; the Sun's altitude is geometric
provenance.grid: one minute inside the dark window; edges interpolated linearly across the crossing minute
provenance.window: the longest run at or above minAltitudeDeg inside the dark window; null edges when there is none; maxAltitudeDeg and maxTime are the run's (the dark window's when there is no run)
